title: PKI session signature fails when the CA certificate is read from the card after a split OPEN SECURE SESSION batch
body:
Hey there, back with some bugs. I'm not sure if it should be posted here or in `keyple-card-calypso-java-lib` so sorry in advance if i'm wrong !

## Versions

keyple-card-calypso-java-lib 3.2.2, keyple-card-calypso-crypto-pki-java-lib 0.2.4.

## Problem:

With a SecurePkiModeTransactionManager, when the card's CA certificate is not registered in the AsymmetricCryptoSecuritySetting and the OPEN SECURE SESSION is processed in a processCommands call that does not also contain the CLOSE SECURE SESSION, the session ends with InvalidCardSignatureException.

## Cause

SecurePkiModeTransactionManagerAdapter reads the CA certificate from the card (two GET DATA, DF4A and DF4B) while parsing the OPEN SECURE SESSION response, so those commands are exchanged inside the open session. CommandGetDataCertificate does not update the terminal session hash, but the card includes them in its session signature. When open, reads and close are in a single batch the CA read happens after the close and the problem is hidden.

## Reproduction

same card, three transactions: CA certificate registered beforehand and session split in three calls: OK. PCA only and the whole session in one call: OK, the CA GET DATA appears after the close. PCA only and session split in three calls: invalid signature, the CA GET DATA appears between the open and the close. Full TRACE log here:

import com.billettiqueservices.dolly.core.aid.AidRegistry
import com.billettiqueservices.dolly.core.apdu.Hex
import com.billettiqueservices.dolly.core.calypso.pki.BundledTrustChains

import org.eclipse.keyple.card.calypso.CalypsoExtensionService

import org.eclipse.keyple.card.calypso.crypto.pki.PkiExtensionService
import org.eclipse.keyple.core.service.SmartCardServiceProvider
import org.eclipse.keyple.plugin.pcsc.PcscPluginFactoryBuilder
import org.eclipse.keypop.calypso.card.GetDataTag
import org.eclipse.keypop.calypso.card.card.CalypsoCard
import org.eclipse.keypop.calypso.card.transaction.AsymmetricCryptoSecuritySetting
import org.eclipse.keypop.calypso.card.transaction.SecurePkiModeTransactionManager
import org.eclipse.keypop.reader.CardReader
import org.eclipse.keypop.reader.ChannelControl
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
import rresult.RResult
import rresult.fold
import kotlin.system.exitProcess

/**
 * Standalone reproduction of a Keyple PKI session problem, run against a real Calypso Prime 3.3 card on PC/SC.
 *
 * Keyple: keyple-card-calypso-java-lib 3.2.2, keyple-card-calypso-crypto-pki-java-lib 0.2.4 (BOM 2026.03.19).
 *
 * Observation: a PKI session whose OPEN SECURE SESSION is processed in its own `processCommands` call (or in any
 * call that does not also contain the CLOSE) fails with `InvalidCardSignatureException` as soon as the card's CA
 * certificate is NOT registered in the `AsymmetricCryptoSecuritySetting`. In that case
 * `SecurePkiModeTransactionManagerAdapter` reads the CA certificate from the card (two GET DATA, tags DF4A/DF4B)
 * while parsing the OPEN SECURE SESSION response, i.e. inside the open session; the card includes those two
 * commands in its session signature, Keyple's `CommandGetDataCertificate` never updates the terminal session
 * hash ("always outside secure session"). When the whole session is one batch, the CA read happens after the
 * CLOSE (responses are parsed once the batch has been exchanged) and nothing is affected.
 *
 * Scenarios, in order:
 *  1. CA certificate registered in the setting, session split in three calls (open / read / close)  -> expected OK
 *  2. Only the PCA registered, whole session in one call                                           -> expected OK
 *  3. Only the PCA registered, session split in three calls                                        -> FAILS
 *
 * Usage: ./gradlew :pki-session-repro:run --args="[--reader <name part>] [--aid <hex>] [--sfi <hex>] [--size <hex>] [--simulate]"
 * `--sfi`/`--size`: the record read inside the session (record 1 of that file; defaults 07 / 1D, the environment file).
 * `--simulate` runs the same program on the KSmITE simulated 3.3 card (use `--sfi 14 --size 20` with it) instead of PC/SC.
 * The log goes to the console and to ./pki-session-repro.log (Keyple at TRACE: every APDU is in it).
 */
private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger("repro")

private class Options(val reader: String?, val aid: String?, val sfi: Byte, val size: Int, val simulate: Boolean)

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val options = parse(args)
    val service = SmartCardServiceProvider.getService()
    val reader: CardReader
    val cleanup: () -> Unit
    if (options.simulate) {
        val stub = ksmite.keyplestubs.plugContactlessReader()
        val fixture = checkNotNull(object {}.javaClass.getResource("/calypso3_hoplink_with_pki.json")).readText()
        stub.inject(ksmite.keyplestubs.KSmITEStubCalypsoCard(fixture))
        reader = stub.reader
        cleanup = { ksmite.keyplestubs.unplugReader(stub) }
        log.info("Using the KSmITE simulated 3.3 card on stub reader '{}'", reader.name)
    } else {
        val plugin = service.registerPlugin(PcscPluginFactoryBuilder.builder().build())
        cleanup = { service.unregisterPlugin(plugin.name) }
        log.info("PC/SC readers: {}", plugin.readerNames)
        reader = plugin.readers.firstOrNull { reader ->
            (options.reader == null || reader.name.contains(options.reader, ignoreCase = true)) && reader.isCardPresent
        } ?: run {
            log.error("No reader with a card present{}", options.reader?.let { " matching '$it'" } ?: "")
            exitProcess(1)
        }
        log.info("Using reader '{}'", reader.name)
    }

    val aid = options.aid ?: findAid(reader) ?: run {
        log.error("No Calypso application selected with the AID registry; pass --aid <hex>")
        exitProcess(1)
    }
    log.info("Application AID: {}", aid)

    val store = PkiTrustStore(BundledTrustChains.load().orExit("bundled trust chains"))
    if (store.hasTestScope) PkiExtensionService.getInstance().setTestMode()

    val results = linkedMapOf<String, String>()
    results["1. CA registered, open / read / close in three calls"] = scenario(reader, aid, options.sfi, store, caFromCard = true) { m ->
        call("prepareOpenSecureSession()") { m.prepareOpenSecureSession() }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
        call("prepareReadRecords(sfi=%02X, 1, 1, size=%d)".format(options.sfi, options.size)) { m.prepareReadRecords(options.sfi, 1, 1, options.size) }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
        call("prepareCloseSecureSession()") { m.prepareCloseSecureSession() }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
    }
    results["2. PCA only, open + read + close in one call"] = scenario(reader, aid, options.sfi, store, caFromCard = false) { m ->
        call("prepareOpenSecureSession()") { m.prepareOpenSecureSession() }
        call("prepareReadRecords(sfi=%02X, 1, 1, size=%d)".format(options.sfi, options.size)) { m.prepareReadRecords(options.sfi, 1, 1, options.size) }
        call("prepareCloseSecureSession()") { m.prepareCloseSecureSession() }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
    }
    results["3. PCA only, open / read / close in three calls"] = scenario(reader, aid, options.sfi, store, caFromCard = false) { m ->
        call("prepareOpenSecureSession()") { m.prepareOpenSecureSession() }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
        call("prepareReadRecords(sfi=%02X, 1, 1, size=%d)".format(options.sfi, options.size)) { m.prepareReadRecords(options.sfi, 1, 1, options.size) }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
        call("prepareCloseSecureSession()") { m.prepareCloseSecureSession() }
        call("processCommands(CLOSE_AFTER)") { m.processCommands(ChannelControl.CLOSE_AFTER) }
    }

    log.info("================ SUMMARY ================")
    results.forEach { (name, outcome) -> log.info("{} -> {}", name, outcome) }
    runCatching(cleanup)
    exitProcess(0) // the plugins keep observation threads alive
}

/**
 * One scenario on a fresh selection (fresh card image, so Keyple has no certificate cached) and a fresh security
 * setting holding the bundled PCA public keys. With [caFromCard], the card's CA certificate is first read OUTSIDE
 * any session and registered in the setting, which is the only difference with the failing scenario.
 */
private fun scenario(
    reader: CardReader, aid: String, sfi: Byte, store: PkiTrustStore, caFromCard: Boolean,
    session: (SecurePkiModeTransactionManager) -> Unit,
): String {
    log.info("")
    log.info("================ SCENARIO: CA {} ================", if (caFromCard) "registered beforehand" else "NOT registered (Keyple will fetch it from the card)")
    val calypso = CalypsoExtensionService.getInstance().calypsoCardApiFactory
    val pki = PkiExtensionService.getInstance()
    val setting = call("createAsymmetricCryptoSecuritySetting() + PCA certificates + certificate parsers") { pcaOnlySetting(store) }
    val card = call("select application $aid") { select(reader, aid) }
    log.info("Card: serial {}, product {}, PKI mode supported={}", Hex.encode(card.applicationSerialNumber), card.productType, card.isPkiModeSupported)
    val manager = call("createSecurePkiModeTransactionManager()") { calypso.createSecurePkiModeTransactionManager(reader, card, setting) }

    if (caFromCard) {
        call("prepareGetData(CA_CERTIFICATE)") { manager.prepareGetData(GetDataTag.CA_CERTIFICATE) }
        call("processCommands(KEEP_OPEN)") { manager.processCommands(ChannelControl.KEEP_OPEN) }
        call("addCaCertificate(createCaCertificate(card.caCertificate)) [%d bytes]".format(card.caCertificate.size)) {
            setting.addCaCertificate(pki.createCaCertificate(card.caCertificate))
        }
    }

    val outcome = runCatching { session(manager) }.fold(
        { "OK (session closed, signature verified)" },
        { t -> "FAILED: " + generateSequence(t) { it.cause?.takeIf { c -> c !== it } }.joinToString(" <- ") { "${it::class.simpleName}: ${it.message}" } },
    )
    log.info("Scenario outcome: {}", outcome)
    log.info("Transaction audit data (APDUs exchanged by this transaction manager, request then response):")
    manager.transactionAuditData.forEachIndexed { i, apdu -> log.info("  [{}] {}", i, Hex.encode(apdu)) }
    return outcome
}

private fun pcaOnlySetting(store: PkiTrustStore): AsymmetricCryptoSecuritySetting {
    val pki = PkiExtensionService.getInstance()
    val setting = CalypsoExtensionService.getInstance().calypsoCardApiFactory
        .createAsymmetricCryptoSecuritySetting(pki.createAsymmetricCryptoCardTransactionManagerFactory())
    store.entries.values.filter { it.isRoot }.forEach { entry ->
        log.debug("addPcaCertificate(reference={})", entry.reference)
        setting.addPcaCertificate(pki.createPcaCertificate(Hex.decode(entry.reference), entry.payload))
    }
    setting.addCaCertificateParser(pki.createCaCertificateParser(CertificateType.CALYPSO_LEGACY))
        .addCardCertificateParser(pki.createCardCertificateParser(CertificateType.CALYPSO_LEGACY))
    return setting
}

private fun select(reader: CardReader, aid: String): CalypsoCard {
    val service = SmartCardServiceProvider.getService()
    val manager = service.readerApiFactory.createCardSelectionManager()
    manager.prepareSelection(
        service.readerApiFactory.createIsoCardSelector().filterByDfName(aid),
        CalypsoExtensionService.getInstance().calypsoCardApiFactory.createCalypsoCardSelectionExtension().acceptInvalidatedCard(),
    )
    return manager.processCardSelectionScenario(reader).activeSmartCard as? CalypsoCard
        ?: error("$aid did not select as a Calypso application")
}

private fun findAid(reader: CardReader): String? = AidRegistry.entries.filter { it.searchable }.firstNotNullOfOrNull { entry ->
    runCatching { select(reader, entry.aidHex) }.getOrNull()?.let { card ->
        log.info("Selected '{}' ({})", entry.name, entry.aidHex)
        Hex.encode(card.dfName).ifEmpty { entry.aidHex }
    }
}

private fun <T> call(description: String, block: () -> T): T {
    log.info("--> {}", description)
    return runCatching(block).onFailure { log.info("<-- {} threw {}: {}", description, it::class.simpleName, it.message) }.getOrThrow()
}

private fun <V, E> RResult<V, E>.orExit(what: String): V =
    fold({ it }, { failure -> log.error("Cannot load {}: {}", what, failure); exitProcess(1) })

private fun parse(args: Array<String>): Options {
    var reader: String? = null
    var aid: String? = null
    var sfi: Byte = 0x07
    var size = 0x1D
    var simulate = false
    var i = 0
    while (i < args.size) {
        when (args[i]) {
            "--reader" -> reader = args[++i]
            "--aid" -> aid = args[++i].uppercase()
            "--sfi" -> sfi = args[++i].toInt(16).toByte()
            "--size" -> size = args[++i].toInt(16)
            "--simulate" -> simulate = true
            else -> { System.err.println("Unknown argument ${args[i]}"); exitProcess(2) }
        }
        i++
    }
    return Options(reader, aid, sfi, size, simulate)
}
